checked_profile.summary: A closer look at Guaranteed Whole Life and its graded death benefit.
checked_profile.scope: The Guaranteed Whole Life offer linked from the provider homepage. Its rules are product-specific and must not be applied to all Mutual of Omaha life policies.

facts.label: Issuing insurer
facts.text: The disclosure identifies United of Omaha Life Insurance Company; in New York, Companion Life Insurance Company underwrites life insurance. Coverage and terms may vary by state.

facts.label: Acceptance and ages
facts.text: The advertised Guaranteed Whole Life product requires no medical exams or health questions. Listed ages are 45–85, or 50–75 in New York. These are not company-wide issue-age limits.

facts.label: First two years
facts.text: For natural-cause death during the first two years, the disclosed benefit is premiums paid plus 10%. Qualifying accidental death has full benefits from issue; full all-cause benefits apply after two years. Outstanding policy loans and policy exclusions still matter.
